notes.note: Reviewed the observed admission mismatch from run 44226098011: ordinary manual dispatch admitted builds inside the six-hour interval, then the unchanged Android/desktop publisher rejected cadence under lock. The entry now delegates ordinary manual requests to the same production decider as schedule; explicit rebuild_index retains its existing path. Terminal recovery now respects a newer unrelated ship's cadence but may finish the newest same-source partial ship. The final source, cadence, ancestry, reservation, signing and provider checks remain intact. Actual workflow shell plus production CLI ran against a private local Git mirror: recent manual/schedule skip, eligible manual and explicit rebuild admit. Baseline and committed mutations reproduce both premature-admission defects; restored tests pass. This is local evidence, not hosted publication or full qualification.

Reviewed the early decision delta: manual dispatch bypass is now limited to the existing explicit rebuild_index path. Default manual requests use the same cadence/reservation decision as schedule before expensive source/native work. Native-release/ring, packaging, context and install guidance retain the same source/artifact and publication boundaries; no provider gate or interval changed. The new workflow-shell integration test executes real Git and the real decider with no external provider calls.

Pure decision tests and committed fault control exercise the rejecting and same-source positive cases.
